# awscc_textract_adapter (Resource)

The AWS::Textract::Adapter resource creates an Amazon Textract adapter, which can be fine-tuned for enhanced performance on user-provided documents.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `adapter_name` (String) The name to be assigned to the adapter being created.
- `feature_types` (List of String) The type of feature that the adapter is being trained on. Currently, supported feature types are: QUERIES

### Optional

- `auto_update` (String) Controls whether or not the adapter should automatically update.
- `description` (String) The description to be assigned to the adapter being created.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of tags to be added to the adapter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `adapter_id` (String) A unique identifier for the adapter resource.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the adapter.
- `creation_time` (String) The date and time that the adapter was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_textract_adapter.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the adapter

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_textract_adapter.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_textract_adapter.example "arn"
```
